name: Squall Palm
description: Strike with a flat palm that releases a short wet gust of qi against the opponent's chest.

name: Gathering Ward
description: Hold a turning ring of mist and wind qi before the body so that blows lose force entering it.

name: Squall Step
description: Step forward on a push of wind qi from the heel to close distance as a blow lands.

name: Rain Sense
description: Spread a thin film of damp qi outward and feel who stands near by the pressure on it.

name: Pelt Flick
description: Flick a handful of stinging droplets from the fingertips at the opponent's eyes and hands.

name: Cuff Deflect
description: Cuff an incoming strike aside with a spinning wrist so the wind qi carries its force wide.

name: Cloudhand
description: Close the fist around a knot of cloud qi and drive it into the ribs with a dull boom.

name: Murk Veil
description: Draw a dim bank of cloud qi around the shoulders so strikes land on soft grey mass.

name: Vapor Slip
description: Thin the body into rising vapor qi for one step so that a swing passes the shoulder.

name: Murk Cuff
description: Backhand with a fist wrapped in heavy cloud qi to knock the target's head sideways.

name: Haze Parry
description: Cross the forearms in a short motion that scrapes an attack off in a haze of damp qi.

name: Prickle Touch
description: Tap the wrist with fingers charged with static so that the hand spasms and drops its grip.

name: Pressure Read
description: Read the change of pressure on the skin to learn from which side the next strike will come.

name: Drumbeat Fist
description: Beat a quick pair of punches into the same spot so storm qi rattles through it like hard rain.

name: Patter Guard
description: Tap a light fast rhythm on a raised forearm so that each blow is broken into many small shocks.

name: Skitter Step
description: Hop lightly from one foot to the other on rain qi to shift the line of attack.

name: Rattle Palm
description: Slap both palms against the target in swift turns so that the qi rattles through the body.

name: Drizzle Flick
description: Snap the fingers to send a fine spray of qi-charged drops across the opponent's face.

name: Beat Reading
description: Tap the ground with a heel and listen to the qi echo to feel what stands near.

name: Anvil Cover
description: Raise both arms and spread a flat topped column of cloud qi above the head to take a falling blow.

name: Thunderhead Fist
description: Rise from a crouch with a fist that carries the stacked storm qi up into the chin.

name: Billow Step
description: Swell the stance forward on a rolling push of cloud qi that crowds the opponent's reach.

name: Towering Drop
description: Bring a stacked forearm down on the shoulder with the whole weight of the gathered qi.

name: Updraft Turn
description: Lift the opponent's strike on a rising current from the palm so that it sails over the head.

name: Lull Breath
description: Breathe slowly together with an ally and settle the qi in both chests so the next strike comes sharper.

name: Grey Stamp
description: Stamp so that a dull wave of heavy qi shakes the opponent's footing and ruins the stance.

name: Rumble Cast
description: Throw a low rolling ball of thunder qi from the palm that booms when it strikes.

name: Hail Fist
description: Pack cold qi into the knuckles and punch so that the blow lands as a bruising pellet.

name: Pellet Scatter
description: Throw a fan of small hard ice-qi pellets from an open hand at the opponent's chest.

name: Sleet Guard
description: Wrap the forearms in a crust of icy qi that turns a blow aside with a crack.

name: Rime Step
description: Skim a thin frost of qi under the feet to slide a long pace without a sound.

name: Frost Elbow
description: Drive a sharp elbow in close with a burst of cold storm qi that numbs the struck place.

name: Pellet Parry
description: Knock a thrown object away with a quick hail-hard flick of the wrist.

name: Chill Rouse
description: Press cool qi against an ally's bruise to draw out the swelling and the heat of the injury.

name: Downpour Slant
description: Set the forearm at a slant like falling rain so that an attack slides off its edge.

name: Weighted Rain
description: Drop a heavy chop onto the collarbone with a falling curtain of qi riding the hand.

name: Streaming Step
description: Pour sideways in a long low step so that the body runs past a swing like water.

name: Puddle Sense
description: Read the weight of qi settled on the ground to feel steps taken nearby and their size.

name: Sluice Shield
description: Pour a sheet of water qi over the guard that spreads the force of a hit across its breadth.

name: Soak Palm
description: Press a sodden palm on the arm to drain the grip out of the muscle for a heartbeat.

name: Pressure Clap
description: Clap the hands shut round the target's head height so that squeezed air bursts in a blunt crack.

name: Compress Guard
description: Hold the qi tight against the skin in a dense film that stiffens at the moment of a hit.

name: Release Step
description: Coil the legs on held qi and let it go to spring a long pace forward.

name: Barometer Touch
description: Rest a hand on the ground and feel the air pressure shift with moving bodies close by.

name: Snap Lash
description: Snap the wrist so a thin cutting whip of compressed wind qi flies at the target's hand.

name: Slackwind Deflect
description: Let the held qi out in a puff on the striking arm to push it off its line.

name: Squeeze Stagger
description: Press the air about the opponent's chest in a sudden squeeze that stops the breath for a moment.

name: Weatherstep
description: Turn on the spot inside a small spinning wind of qi that carries the body a long pace aside.

name: Eddy Palm
description: Spin out of the turn with a palm that carries the whole wind of the step behind it.

name: Eddy Guard
description: Spin a small eddy of qi about the body that sucks the force out of attacks passing near.

name: Whirl Deflect
description: Wheel the forearm in a full circle to wind a weapon off line and out of the hand.

name: Spin Lash
description: Fling a thin ring of whirling qi from the hand that cuts across the opponent's guard.

name: Cyclone Tread
description: Circle the opponent in a quick tight orbit with a trailing wind that pulls at his stance.

name: Wind Cover
description: Turn a light wind about an ally's legs and arms so that each step and swing comes easier.

name: Giddy Whirl
description: Wheel a fast whirl of air past the ears so the opponent loses the sense of which way is level.
